method.method_draft: Cell-by-cell simulation. First read the picture as a 4 by 4 grid with columns A-D and rows 1-4; black obstacle cells are B3, C2, and C1, and the arrow in A2 points right/east. From the text, use the rule: move forward through white cells; when the next cell is a black cell or outside the grid, turn right; if after that right turn the next cell is still blocked, stop. Execute the states in order: start A2 facing east, move to B2; C2 is blocked, turn south; move to B1; border blocks south, turn west; move to A1; border blocks west, turn north; move through A2, A3, A4; border blocks north, turn east; move through B4, C4, D4; border blocks east, turn south; move through D3, D2, D1. At D1 the south border is in front, and after turning right to face west, C1 is black, so it stops at D1.
